Two things motivating this: (1) our vendor consolidation means we have a short-term cashflow blip, and (2) some of our EU subsidiaries are still completing VAT registration which delays reclaiming.

We want to be good partners and can provide the following in return:
- PO #9421 for the initial three-month commitment (attached).
- A 20% PO-anchored retainage (held in an agreed escrow) on invoices until VAT certificate & reconciliation is completed.
- Commitment to move to Net30 after the first pilot tranche if the VAT routing is cleared earlier.

Can you confirm what Redwood would need in terms of:
- Evidence files (VAT certificate, SOC2, sample invoices)
- Credit review timeline and credit limit you might approve
- Any commercial concession or discount for a short Net60 pilot

Thanks — appreciate a quick read and whether this is something we can agree to this week.

Soojin / Laura — quick commercial thoughts:

1) Option A (recommended compromise):
- Start with Net45 for 90 days.
- Require PO #9421 and a 20% PO-anchored retainage placed into escrow within 10 business days of the first invoice.
- If MedAlign delivers VAT certificate + reconciliation within 60 days, escalate to Net60 for the remainder of the pilot and release retainage on first cleared invoices.
- Offer a 1% early-pay credit if payments arrive within 15 days.

2) Option B (more conservative):
- Redwood extends to Net60 immediately but requires a refundable deposit of 15% up front against the first two invoices and a formal escrow arrangement for the retainage.

From a sales standpoint, Option A preserves cashflow while being a gesture toward MedAlign's request. It also avoids hat-on-head approvals for Net60 immediately.

Hi all — Finance review completed after checking MedAlign's credit references and the PO. Summary and conditions below: 

- Provisional credit cap: $350,000 for the pilot period, conditional on PO #9421 and the escrow/retainage arrangement.
- Required documents before first invoice clearing:
  * Signed PO (we have the attached PDF)
  * Copy of VAT registration or VAT-in-process confirmation (we can accept a certificate of application + expected grant date)
  * Standard KYC packet (company registration, two trade refs)
  * SOC2 Type II (or equivalent) — we can accept an attestation link
- Escrow: We will accept a third-party escrow (we use the TrustEdge escrow template). Retainage: 20% of each invoice, released as VAT evidence is provided or after 90 days if reconciliation confirms no liability.
- Operational timeline: 2 business days post-receipt of full docs to enable provisional credit and escrow instructions.

Commercial concession: Redwood can approve Option A (Net45 for 90 days, then move to Net60 upon VAT evidence) with a 1% early-pay credit for payments within 15 days. If MedAlign requires Net60 immediately, Finance will require a 15% refundable deposit up front.

I'll attach the draft terms we typically use for PO-anchored retainage (Redwood_TermSheet_v3.docx). Once we have the signed PO and KYC, we can kick off escrow wiring instructions.
